resources.string: Blockify uses the AccessibilityService API for real-time adult content filtering, impulse prevention, and parental control. Active screen text and app window titles are inspected 100% locally on-device. No personal data, passwords, keystrokes, or screen content is stored or transmitted.
Optional self-discipline and parental control protection to prevent impulsive deactivation or uninstallation. Can be disabled at any time using the in-app Emergency Stop feature.
Pause and breathe. Your focus is guarded.
Blockify is guarding your attention. Modifying or disabling protection is blocked.
You\'re viewing Blockify\'s App Info. Changes here may stop your protection.
Your request to disable protection has been received. Protection will remain active for 2 hours.
This records a local aggregate count and suppresses recent false triggers. No screen text or private data is ever shared.
